plan.name: Marathon Goal 4h15
plan.description: 12-week plan designed to achieve a 4h15 marathon. 4 sessions per week focusing on progressiveness and controlled volume. Ideal for a regular recreational runner.

cycles.name: Phase 1: General Development
cycles.description: Building aerobic base and speed development. Accustoming the body to running 4 times a week.

sessions.name: Playful Fartlek
sessions.description: 45 min including 8x 30s fast / 30s slow to energize the stride without exhaustion.

sessions.name: Weekly Long Run
sessions.description: 1h15 pure endurance. The pillar of the week.

sessions.name: Short Intervals
sessions.description: 10x 30s/30s. Slightly more intensity volume than last week.

sessions.name: Short Threshold
sessions.description: 3 repetitions of 6 minutes at a sustained pace (Half-Marathon/10km effort).

sessions.name: Speed Recall
sessions.description: A few short accelerations (6x 45s) to keep rhythm without fatigue.

cycles.name: Phase 2: Specific Development
cycles.description: Core of the training. Longer runs and work at Marathon Pace (4h15 = ~6:02/km).

sessions.name: Long Threshold
sessions.description: 2 x 10 minutes at Threshold pace (faster than marathon pace).

sessions.name: Specific Long Run
sessions.description: 1h45 with 20 min at Marathon Pace (6:02/km) in the middle.

sessions.name: Marathon Pace
sessions.description: 2 x 15 min at target pace (4h15 pace).

sessions.name: MP Reminders
sessions.description: 30 min warmup + 15 min marathon pace + 10 min cool down.

cycles.name: Phase 3: Peak & Taper
cycles.description: The longest run, then progressive tapering to arrive fresh at the start line.

sessions.name: Threshold / MP
sessions.description: 3 x 10 min marathon pace to lock in the rhythm.

sessions.name: The Longest Run
sessions.description: 2h30, the longest run of the plan. 80% endurance, finish with 15' marathon pace if feeling good.

sessions.name: Pace Reminder
sessions.description: 2 x 10 min marathon pace, but reduced total volume.

sessions.name: Shake-out Run
sessions.description: 30 min very slow to get blood flowing.

sessions.name: Activation
sessions.description: 20 min easy + 3 accelerations of 30s. Just for neural activation.

sessions.name: Total Rest
sessions.description: Complete rest, hydration, and carb loading.

sessions.name: MARATHON
sessions.description: Race Day. Cautious start, objective consistency 6:02/km.
